transcript: To add this feature to your website where buyers can see products in real time or even try on your products, you need 3D render files. But like me, if you don't know how to make them, here's how you can do it using AI. Take multiple images of your product and go to this tool. Now upload the images to multi-angle view and then set the texture to 8K to get super sharp details of your 3D model. Then export it and download a .GLB file. Now go to your Amazon or Shopify store and select your product and add your product details and then simply drag and drop a GLB file here. Then on your phone press view in your space to see model live in action. So if you want to try this out, just comment 3D and I'll send you the link.
caption:
Here’s how to add virtual try-on and ‘view in your space’ feature to your ecommerce website or amazon. 

Because buyers who can see products on themselves or in their own room convert way better. 

Comment “3D” and ill send you the link. :)
